This [[Gender/Legends|Female]] '''individual''' who resided in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Telos IV]] was the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Tharston Kharl]], an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Miner/Legends|miner]] who worked in [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] [[Sarnus Refinery|refinery]] on [[Sarnus]]. Despite being married, Kharl carried on an affair with [[Dena Yus]], a [[biot]] created by [[Galactic Exploitation Technologies]] to spy on Lando's operations.<ref name="Crucible (novel)" />
